rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a movie theatre or movie house.

example.english: We’re going to the cinema tonight to watch a movie.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 hei3 jyun2 tai2 hei3

rows.note: Use this all-purpose word when referring to films collectively rather than to a theatre.

example.english: Cinema has changed a lot over the past few years.
example.jyutping: ni1 gei2 nin4 din6 jing2 bin3 faa3 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this colloquial term for the film industry as a professional or social sphere.

example.english: They’ve worked in the cinema industry for over ten years.
example.traditional: 佢喺電影圈打滾咗十幾年。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 din6 jing2 hyun1 daa2 gwan2 zo2 sap6 gei2 nin4

rows.note: Use this formal term when discussing filmmaking as an art form or cinematography.

example.english: Cinema is not just about storytelling; it also requires attention to visuals.
example.traditional: 電影藝術唔單止係講故事，仲要講究畫面。
example.jyutping: din6 jing2 ngai6 seot6 m4 daan1 zi2 hai6 gong2 gu3 si6 zung6 jiu3 gong2 gau3 waa6 min6
